sn17.21:1.1: Sāvatthi || || Dāruṇo bhikkhave lābhasakkārasiloko || pe|| || Na tassa bhikkhave mātugāmo eko ekassa cittam pariyādāya tiṭṭhati yassa lābhasakkārasiloko cittam pariyādāya tiṭṭhati || pe|| Evaṃ dāruṇo kho bhikkhave lābhasakkārasiloko || pe || || Evañhi vo bhikkhave sikkhitabbanti || || Pathamaṃ || ||
